why: Backing up paid off: I can now see a full gate structure (two vertical posts with rungs/crossbar, a light-blue lintel at top) sitting slightly right of center in the forward view. The policy wants to turn further left (+19deg), which would push the gate further out to the right edge of frame -- wrong direction for lining up. Overriding with a moderate forward step and a small right turn instead, to center the gate in the frame and close some distance before committing to the pass-through line.
